message: I've been thinking a lot about how much fun it can be to step back from our screens and rediscover the simple joys of life. One way to do this is by getting our families prepared for anything that may come our way. There’s a wonderful resource that helps you gather everything you might need in an emergency kit — it’s a great activity to do together! 🛠️ Plus, it’s a lovely reminder that sometimes, the best memories come from working together on little projects. Have you made an emergency kit yet?
